title: HTML Challenge: Build a Real Page
description: Synthesize the entire HTML module into a production-grade webpage: unite semantic landmarks, headings, media, structured data tables, and accessible interactive forms into one coherent document.

objectives.statement: Synthesize semantic landmarks, headings, media, tables, and forms into a cohesive, accessible HTML document.
Audit and debug an HTML document for nesting errors, missing alt text, and broken form label associations.

content.title: Module 1-1 Capstone: The Complete Web Page
content.hook: You have mastered the individual building blocks of HTML. Now, you will bring them together into a complete, accessible, semantic web page.
content.context: Professional frontend engineers build interfaces where every single element serves a clear semantic purpose: landmarks guide navigation, headings outline content, tables present data, and forms capture user input cleanly.
goals: Construct a multi-section semantic webpage from scratch.
Include landmarks, headings, images, tables, and forms.
Perform a comprehensive HTML quality and accessibility audit.

content.title: Full Page Architectural Blueprint
content.description: Blueprint: <header> with <h1> & <nav> -> <main> with <section> (content + <table> of skills) and <section> (<form> for contact) -> <footer> with copyright.

testCases.description: Must have header, nav, main, and footer landmarks
Header must contain an <h1> title with text 'Developer Portfolio'
Main must contain a table with thead headers and tbody
Main must contain a form with label, input, and submit button
testCases.assertion: document.querySelector('main form input#user-msg') && document.querySelector('main form input#user-msg').getAttribute('name') === 'message'

feedback.correct: Masterpiece! You engineered a complete, production-grade semantic HTML webpage combining all architectural patterns from Module 1-1.
feedback.incorrect: Review all required components: verify `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>` (with table and form), and `<footer>` are all present and properly nested.

content.bugDescription: The image is missing an alt attribute, the label does not match the input id, and the table markup is unclosed.

testCases.description: Image element must have an alt attribute
Label 'for' attribute must match the input 'id' (email-field)
Table rows must be properly formed and closed

feedback.correct: Flawless audit! You caught and fixed the missing alt text, corrected the label association, and repaired the table structure.
feedback.incorrect: Check that the image has an `alt` attribute, the label has `for="email-field"`, and all table tags are cleanly closed.

content.title: Module 1-1 Mastery Certified
content.message: You have completed the HTML & Structure foundational milestone! You are now capable of writing production-ready, semantic, accessible HTML5 documents that integrate document outlines, hyperlinks, media paths, tabular data, and interactive forms.
content.congratulations: Congratulations on certifying your foundational HTML engineering skills!
